name: Google Contacts Sync
description: One-way sync of your Google Contacts into the 'Google Contacts' address book.
author: Michael Richter

clientId.label: Google OAuth Client ID
clientId.description: Deployment-wide OAuth client for the whole server. Registered once in Google Cloud Console with the redirect URI <origin>/<locale>/plugins/oauth/callback. All users share this client; each authorizes their own Google account.

clientSecret.label: Google OAuth Client Secret
clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret for Google 'Web application' client ID.

addressBookName.label: Address book name
addressBookName.description: Name of the address book where Google Contacts are synced.

syncOnLogin.label: Sync contacts on login
syncOnLogin.description: Automatically sync contacts when you login.

syncPeriodically.label: Sync contacts periodically
syncPeriodically.description: Sync runs on app start and window focus.

syncIntervalMinutes.label: Minimum minutes between automatic syncs
syncIntervalMinutes.description: Sync runs at most once per this interval.

showToasts.label: Show toast notifications
showToasts.description: Show toast messages when sync starts and completes.
